verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a dedicated Scheduled Flags feature that queues flag changes and applies them automatically at a specified future time, which directly covers the core of the story. Release Pipelines add automated stage progression with triggers, but the evidence does not say those triggers can be time-based. Missing for 10: detail on how scheduling works (UI vs API, time zones, which change types can be scheduled, plan availability), explicit time-based scheduling of release-pipeline stages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
